logger.doc:name: start billing process creation
logger.message: #["Starting Billing Process Creation: " ++ vars.processCode default "UNKNOWN" ++ ", Service ID: " ++ vars.serviceId default "0"]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn = "everywhere" --- { "transactionId": correlationId, "status": upper(payload.message) default "SUCCESS", "createdAt": now() as String {format: "YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"}, "result": { "customerId": payload.result.custId, "accountId": payload.result.acctId, "serviceId": vars.serviceId, "zsmartResponseCode": payload.result.responseCode, "zsmartMessage": payload.result.responseMessage } }

logger.doc:name: end billing process creation

logger.doc:name: start billing process update
logger.message: #["Starting Billing Process Update: " ++ vars.processCode default "UNKNOWN" ++ ", Service ID: " ++ vars.serviceId default "0"]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import * from dw::Runtime output application/json var processCode = vars.processCode match { case "PLAN_CHANGE" -> "patchPlanChange" case "SVA" -> "patchSva" case "SUSPENSION" -> "patchSuspension" case "RESTORATION" -> "patchRestoration" case "NUMBER_CHANGE" -> "patchNumberChange" case "VOLUNTARY_CANCELLATION" -> "patchVoluntaryCancel" case "ADD_CHARGE" -> "patchAddCharge" //case "SERVICE_REMOVAL" -> "patchServiceRemoval" case "STRATUM_CHANGE" -> "patchStratumChange" case "OWNERSHIP_TRANSFER" -> "patchOwnershipTransfer" case "BILLING_CYCLE_CHANGE" -> "patchBillingCycleChange" case "CUSTOMER_UPDATE" -> "patchCustomerUpdate" case "ACCOUNT_UPDATE" -> "patchAccountUpdate" case "ADDRESS_CHANGE" -> "patchAddressChange" else -> fail("Invalid Process Code") } var requestHeaders = attributes.headers --- { host: p('zsmart-sapi.host'), port: p('zsmart-sapi.port'), basepath: p('zsmart-sapi.base-path'), path: p('zsmart-sapi.' ++ processCode ++ ".path"), method: p('zsmart-sapi.' ++ processCode ++ ".method"), headers: { "client_secret": p('zsmart-sapi.security.client_secret'), "client_id": p('zsmart-sapi.security.client_id'), "name": requestHeaders.name, "X-CORRELATION-ID": requestHeaders."X-CORRELATION-ID", "source": requestHeaders.source, "systemId": requestHeaders.systemId }, queryParameters: { }, uriParameters: { }, responseTimeout: p('configurationTimeout.zsmart-sapi.responseTimeout') }

%dw 2.0 import * from dw::Runtime output application/java --- (vars.processCode) match { case "PLAN_CHANGE" -> readUrl('classpath://dwScripts/patchBillingProcess/planChangeMapping.dwl', 'text/plain') case "SVA" -> readUrl('classpath://dwScripts/patchBillingProcess/svaMapping.dwl', 'text/plain') case "SUSPENSION" -> readUrl('classpath://dwScripts/patchBillingProcess/suspensionMapping.dwl', 'text/plain') case "RESTORATION" -> readUrl('classpath://dwScripts/patchBillingProcess/restorationMapping.dwl', 'text/plain') case "NUMBER_CHANGE" -> readUrl('classpath://dwScripts/patchBillingProcess/numberChangeMapping.dwl', 'text/plain') case "VOLUNTARY_CANCELLATION" -> readUrl('classpath://dwScripts/patchBillingProcess/voluntaryCancelMapping.dwl', 'text/plain') case "ADD_CHARGE" -> readUrl('classpath://dwScripts/patchBillingProcess/addChargeMapping.dwl', 'text/plain') //case "SERVICE_REMOVAL" -> readUrl('classpath://dwScripts/patchBillingProcess/serviceRemovalMapping.dwl', 'text/plain') case "STRATUM_CHANGE" -> readUrl('classpath://dwScripts/patchBillingProcess/stratumChangeMapping.dwl', 'text/plain') case "OWNERSHIP_TRANSFER" -> readUrl('classpath://dwScripts/patchBillingProcess/ownershipTransferMapping.dwl', 'text/plain') case "BILLING_CYCLE_CHANGE" -> readUrl('classpath://dwScripts/patchBillingProcess/billingCycleChangeMapping.dwl', 'text/plain') case "CUSTOMER_UPDATE" -> readUrl('classpath://dwScripts/patchBillingProcess/customerUpdateMapping.dwl', 'text/plain') case "ACCOUNT_UPDATE" -> readUrl('classpath://dwScripts/patchBillingProcess/accountUpdateMapping.dwl', 'text/plain') case "ADDRESS_CHANGE" -> readUrl('classpath://dwScripts/patchBillingProcess/addressChangeMapping.dwl', 'text/plain') else -> fail("Invalid Process Code") }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json skipNullOn = "everywhere" --- { "transactionId": correlationId, "status": upper(payload.message) default "SUCCESS", "createdAt": now() as String {format: "YYYY-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"}, "result": { "customerId": payload.result.custId, "accountId": payload.result.acctId, "serviceId": vars.serviceId, "zsmartResponseCode": payload.result.responseCode, "zsmartMessage": payload.result.responseMessage } }

logger.doc:name: end billing process update
logger.message: #["Ended Billing Process Update: " ++ vars.processCode default "UNKNOWN" ++ ", Service ID: " ++ vars.serviceId default "0"]
